account_id.description: The revenue account the line earns.

description.description: What the line is for, as the customer reads it.

discount_percent.description: A discount off the line, as a percentage with at most two decimals. The line's net is RND-LINE: quantity × unit price × (100 − discount) ÷ 100, rounded once to the currency's minor units, half away from zero.

gst_code.description: The line's GST code for supplies, from the sg-gst pack in force at the invoice's date, such as SR (standard-rated), ZR (zero-rated), ES (exempt) or OS (out of scope). No GST is charged before the organisation is GST-registered.

item_id.description: The item it sells, if any; the line keeps its own description, price and account.

quantity.description: How many, an exact decimal with up to 6 decimals; 1 for a single amount.

spread_from.description: The spread's first month, as any day of it: when the service starts. Left out, the invoice's month. Months before the invoice's date release on its date.

spread_months.description: Spread the line's revenue over this many months (FR-GL-03): issuing puts its net on 2400 Deferred revenue in the base currency, and one part a month (ALLOC-EVEN) is released to the line's account by the scheduler, up to the organisation's today and never ahead (ENG-05).

unit_price.description: The price of one before GST, in the invoice's currency, an exact decimal with up to 6 decimals.
